page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfg6.20xlarge is a dedicated ECS Bare Metal server instance configured with 80 dedicated vCPUs using an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 3.1 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor foundation, the hardware provides consistent processing capacity without multi-tenant host virtualization overhead. System memory is provisioned at 384 GB, delivering an allocation ratio of 4.8 GB per core.

The instance does not bundle local storage disks, requiring all persistent storage and operational filesystems to connect through external network-attached block devices. Network capability is backed by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth configuration, facilitating high-throughput inter-node communications and external data transfers. The server includes zero discrete GPUs and does not supply complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its 3.1 GHz high-frequency Intel Xeon cores and balanced 4.8 GB per core memory footprint, the server is architectured for workloads demanding high single-thread throughput alongside deep parallel scaling. Appropriate production environments include large-scale web serving tiers, high-throughput in-memory caching layers, enterprise application runtimes, container orchestration nodes, and distributed batch processing pipelines.
